SECANT PILING

Secant Piling Tender Exclusions That Deserve a Second Look

A buyer’s checklist for identifying missing work before a contract is agreed.

In this insight

Read exclusions as part of the priceCheck enabling and access obligationsFollow material and water interfacesClose the gaps in writingFor your project discussionDiscuss a project ↗

Educational overview · Project-specific design and execution require qualified review.

Read exclusions as part of the price

A secant piling quotation is only meaningful alongside its exclusions. An excluded activity does not disappear; it moves to another package or becomes an unresolved obligation. Build a side-by-side comparison of the commercial offers and mark every excluded item. The objective is not to reject all exclusions but to ensure that each required activity has a responsible party and an allowance.

Check enabling and access obligations

Common discussion points include site clearance, obstruction treatment, access preparation, working platforms, service information and available working space. Ask how the contractor has interpreted the tender documents and what evidence supports readiness. If the employer is providing something, define its acceptance process and required date. Vague wording such as suitable access can leave both parties with a different expectation.

Follow material and water interfaces

Trace spoil, concrete, reinforcement and water through the proposed operation. Identify who handles transport, disposal documentation, temporary storage and associated permissions. Clarify where wall construction ends and excavation, support installation or water management begins. Do not treat these questions as administrative detail: a missing interface can affect the ability to perform otherwise well-defined work.

Close the gaps in writing

Use a clarification register that records the question, response, price effect and final contract reference. Ensure the accepted proposal and the scope schedule agree. If an item remains uncertain, state how it will be assessed and authorised rather than allowing an informal understanding to become a disputed assumption. A clean award package is a better foundation for collaboration than an apparently low price supported by unresolved qualifications.

For your project discussion

Use these questions to structure a conversation with the project’s qualified design and delivery team. This article is general procurement guidance, not a site-specific design, method statement or compliance assessment. The cited international resources provide background; applicable local requirements and the approved project documents govern the work.

Take this into your next conversation

  • Price the complete required scope.
  • Assign every excluded activity.
  • Transfer clarifications into the signed documents.
